_about: Declared BEFORE any evaluation data was seen (2026-09-22). Inputs: CONTRACT.md §2 and mapping.py only. HA intent + slot conditions -> canonical Home-app calls. Anything not listed maps to [] (no call). See MAPPING.md for the reasoning.

satellite_context._about: Passed to hassil as intent_context on every request: the speaker's satellite is in the room the contract calls 'here'. Templates whose slot combination is context_area copy it into the area slot.

areas._about: HA areas = our six rooms. key = area value_out (canonical room); list = every text_in hassil accepts for it (the name itself + CONTRACT §2 synonyms as area aliases). 'whole house' and 'here' are NOT areas: they come from the upstream <everywhere> / <here> rules and the satellite context.

floors._about: No floors are declared (the contract has none), so every {floor} template can never match.

entities._about: The {name} slot list. One light entity per area (HA-style entity name), one vacuum, one smart plug. Aliases for the vacuum and plug are exactly the device words of CONTRACT §2. The plug and vacuum have no area.

rules.when: domain == light, no name, area slot present
domain == light, no name, no area slot (the domain_all combination)
name resolves to a light entity; if an area slot is also present it must equal the entity's area, else []
name resolves to switch.smart_plug and no area slot
brightness slot present; integer 1..100 else []; target = area slot | here-context | named light entity's area
color slot present and in COLORS (white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink); black, brown, turquoise -> []
temperature slot matched by NAME: 'warm white' -> warm white; 'cool white'/'cold white'/'daylight'/'day light' -> cool white; 'candle light' and any numeric kelvin -> []
area slot (spoken, or 'here' from the satellite context); a name, if present, must be vacuum.robot

unmapped_intents._about: Deliberately unmapped: every other intent in the shipped English grammar (HassGetState, HassClimate*, HassFanSetSpeed, HassMedia*, HassSetVolume*, timers, lists, HassNevermind, HassRespond, HassBroadcast, HassSetPosition, HassLawnMower*, HassGetWeather, HassGetCurrentDate/Time, HassShoppingList*, HassList*). A match on any of them returns []. Also []: HassTurnOn/Off on domain fan, on cover device classes, on scenes/scripts.
unmapped_intents.reason: None of them corresponds to one of the five Home-app actions; a match on them is the grammar correctly declining (e.g. 'are the lights on' -> HassGetState).

unreachable_canonical.vacuum stop: No English intent stops a vacuum (no HassVacuumStop / pause; HassTurnOff's name domains exclude vacuum).
unreachable_canonical.set_light_color warm/cool white via 'war: Only the named colour temperatures above exist upstream.
